change: Personal battle XP is allocated after each attack or DOT death; death erases only that unit's battle increment, and escape preserves it below the next-level threshold.
edition: Steam Disciples II: Rise of the Elves

status_names.note: Structure/status names only. Mod hook behavior is not treated as original game behavior.

implementation.diagnostic_totals: battle_xp[2] still records killed-unit XP for existing reward/report consumers; never divided at finalization
implementation.dot_order: Queue helpers optionally return per-slot death order across the current and next round. Allocation uses fixed-size JAX arrays, with no host callbacks.
implementation.summons: No XP share or kill value. The accumulator under a summoned replacement retains the escaped permanent fighter's XP until roster restoration.
implementation.revival: Death resets the battle increment; native and item revivals start at zero. Pre-battle unit_xp is retained.
implementation.finalization: Both sides, once after post-battle healing. Escape limits the addition below promotion; enemy_progress persists enemy XP.
implementation.observation: Expose personal uncredited XP in the former revival cutoff feature positions (v25+); older progression observation versions add twelve features. Existing policy semantics change.
